source.symbol: Generated patch, local configuration and editor ignore patterns
source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
# Generated by hg or patch (e.g. revert, failed patch, ...)
*.orig
*.rej

# Still add Cargo.toml.orig and dotfiles in third_party/rust because cargo
# vendored crates contain those files, which some other rules ignore.
# lint-ignore-next-line: syntax-difference
!third_party/rust/**/Cargo.toml.orig
# lint-ignore-next-line: syntax-difference
!third_party/rust/**/.*

# User files that may appear at the root
/.clang-tidy
/.clangd
/.mozconfig*
/mozconfig*
/.moz-fast-forward
/.moz-vendoring
/old-configure
/config.cache
/config.log
/.clang_complete
/machrc
/.machrc

# Ignore Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code workspace files.
.vs/
.vscode/
*.user

# Ignore Zed editor configuration files.
.zed/
